blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: У Сильвии был строгий отец, ___ (which, who) никогда её не хвалил.
exercises.prompt: Silvia had a stern father who never praised her.
exercises.why: **который** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. sg. m. or nom. sg. m.).

exercises.q: Вскоре приехал и экскаватор, ___ (which, who) прорыл через покрытый ромашками холм дорогу.
exercises.prompt: Pretty soon along came a steam shovel and dug a road through the hill covered with daisies.
exercises.why: **который** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. sg. m. or nom. sg. m.).

exercises.q: Своё название броненосец получил благодаря броне, ___ (which, who) покрывает его спину.
exercises.prompt: It acquired the name "armadillo" thanks to the armor that covers its back.
exercises.why: **которая** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: nom. sg. f.).

exercises.q: Это самая большая нелепость, ___ (which, whom) я когда-либо слышал.
exercises.prompt: This is the most ridiculous thing I have ever heard.
exercises.why: **которую** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. sg. f.).

exercises.q: Начальник Тома был требовательным и занудным, ему приходилось проверять каждую мелочь, ___ (which, whom) делал Том.
exercises.prompt: Tom's boss was a pedantic micro manager, who had to check every single thing Tom did.
exercises.why: **которую** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. sg. f.).

exercises.q: Аварский язык, на ___ (which, whom) говорят аварцы относится к семейству языков Северо-Восточного Кавказа.
exercises.prompt: The Avar language spoken by the Avars belongs to the family of Northeast Caucasian languages.
exercises.why: **котором** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: prep. sg. m. or prep. sg. n.).

exercises.q: Эндометрит - заболевание, при ___ (which, whom) бактерии проникают в матку и вызывают воспаление внутренней мембраны.
exercises.prompt: Endometritis is a disease where bacteria enter the uterus and cause inflammation of the inner membrane.
exercises.why: **котором** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: prep. sg. m. or prep. sg. n.).

exercises.q: У женщин, у матерей или сестёр ___ (which, whom) эндометриоз, существует повышенный риск развития этого заболевания.
exercises.prompt: Women with mothers or sisters who have endometriosis are at elevated risk of developing the condition themselves.
exercises.why: **которых** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. pl. or gen. pl. or prep. pl.).

exercises.q: Поле, на ___ (which, whom) мы раньше играли в мяч, сейчас застроено.
exercises.prompt: The field where we used to play ball is now all built up.
exercises.why: **котором** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: prep. sg. m. or prep. sg. n.).

exercises.q: Вы так же коррумпированы, как и политики, ___ (which, whom) вы порицаете.
exercises.prompt: You're as corrupt as the politicians you condemn.
exercises.why: **которых** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. pl. or gen. pl. or prep. pl.).

exercises.q: На моей рубашке надоедливая складка, ___ (which, whom) я не могу убрать утюгом.
exercises.prompt: There's a pesky wrinkle on my shirt that I just can't get the iron to remove.
exercises.why: **которую** — «который» takes its gender and number from the noun it refers to and its case from its own clause (here: acc. sg. f.).
